from io import BytesIO
from zipfile import ZipFile

def entries(blob):
    with ZipFile(BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
        return [(entry.filename,archive.read(entry)) for entry in archive.infolist() if not entry.is_dir()]

# text-bundle-reader

行为约定：
bundle.service.load_texts(blob) reads a ZIP byte string and returns a dict of normalized relative paths to decoded text for non-directory entries with case-sensitive '.txt' suffix. Validate ALL names before filtering: reject POSIX absolute names, Windows drive-qualified names, backslashes and any '..' segment with ValueError; discard empty and '.' segments to normalize. Ignore directory entries; reject any normalized duplicate among selected text files. Decode using UTF-8 with one optional leading BOM removed, raising UnicodeDecodeError on invalid text. Keep nested paths rather than basenames. No extraction to disk.

运行：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。

from io import BytesIO
from zipfile import ZipFile
from .paths import normalize

def entries(blob):
    with ZipFile(BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
        result = []
        for entry in archive.infolist():
            name = normalize(entry.filename)
            if not entry.is_dir():
                result.append((name,archive.read(entry)))
        return result
